content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am looking forward to getting started. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a few small adjustments. Specifically: - Regarding the limitation of liability, the relevant clause currently carves out indemnification obligations, which leaves exposure for indemnity claims completely uncapped. I propose that we update the agreement so that the limitation of liability applies to all claims, including indemnification obligations, while keeping the exception for breaches of confidentiality. Thank you for your time and understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this soon.
